title: 第18章 守卫大人，想问个事
novel_title: 巫师：让你学知识，你杀穿万界？
content_zh:
伊森走到柜台前，“想买个储物戒指。”

    光头男人挑了挑眉，转身从身后一个货架上取下一个巴掌大的木盒，放在柜台上打开。

    盒子里静静躺着五枚戒指。样式各异，有的镶嵌着晶石，有的刻满符文，有的则朴素得如同寻常铁环。

    “这些都是学徒级储物巫器，最低等的那种，是学院里一些巫师大人随手练手做出来的。空间不大，胜在稳定、耐用，不会轻易损坏，也不会出现空间坍塌。对你们新生来说，足够用了。”

    伊森目光落在最角落一枚毫无装饰、通体呈淡灰色的戒指上。

    “那一枚。”

    店主顺着他的目光看去，有些意外：“客人好眼光，这一枚是最基础的款式，内部空间只有一立方米，功能单一，没有任何额外增幅。但也正因为如此，它结构最简单，几乎不可能出故障，坚固程度也远超其他几枚。”

    “价格。”

    “二十魔石。” 店主爽快报价，“不二价。”

    伊森没有犹豫，直接取出魔石。

    光头男人接过魔石，随手清点了一下，满意地点了点头。

    “成了。”他把戒指推到伊森面前，“滴血就能认主。认主之后，只有你能用。就算丢了，别人捡去也没用，除非用暴力破解，但那玩意儿一破解就炸，里面的东西全得碎。”

    伊森拿起戒指，塞进怀里。

    “谢了。”

    他转身走出铺子便转身朝宿舍区方向走去。

    回到宿舍区门口时，伊森停下脚步。

    大门左侧，一根粗壮的石柱旁，有一具骷髅。

    它靠坐在石柱根部，两条腿骨伸直搭在地上，脊骨弯成个舒服的弧度，脑袋微微垂着，一副正在打盹的模样。

    “额，灵骨守卫也会偷懒的啊？稀奇。”

    听到脚步声，那骷髅抬起头，魂火跳动了两下。

    “新生？”灵骨守卫声音懒洋洋的，“瞎逛什么？”

    伊森从怀里摸出一枚魔石，“守卫大人，想问个事。”

    那骷髅的魂火跳动了一下。

    “哟，懂规矩。”它接过魔石，随手塞进袍子里，“问吧。”

    伊森从怀里取出那枚刚买的储物戒指，递了过去。

    “这个，有问题吗？”

    灵骨守卫接过戒指，翻来覆去看了两眼。它抬起另一只骨手，指尖点在戒指表面，指尖处亮起一点幽绿的光芒。

    大约三息后，它收回手，把戒指扔回给伊森。

    “没问题。”它重新靠回石柱，语气依旧是那副懒洋洋的腔调，“这储物巫器结构简单得很，没什么花活。滴血就认主，认主之后只有你能用。想动什么手脚？犯不上。”
content_en:
Ethan walked to the counter, "I want to buy a storage ring."

    The bald man raised his eyebrows, turned around and took down a palm-sized wooden box from a shelf behind him, placed it on the counter and opened it.

    Five rings lay quietly in the box. There are different styles, some are inlaid with crystal stones, some are engraved with runes, and some are as simple as ordinary iron rings.

    "These are apprentice-level storage witchcraft, the lowest kind. They were made by some wizards in the academy with random practice. They are not big in space, but they are stable and durable. They will not be easily damaged, and there will be no space collapse. They are enough for you freshmen."

    Ethan's eyes fell on an undecorated, light gray ring in the far corner.

    "That one."

    The shop owner followed his gaze and was a little surprised: "The customer is very discerning, this one is the most basic model, with only one cubic meter of internal space, single function, and no additional increase. But because of this, it has the simplest structure, is almost impossible to malfunction, and is far stronger than the others."

    "Price."

    "Twenty magic stones." The shopkeeper quoted the price readily, "No price."

    Ethan didn't hesitate and took out the magic stone.

    The bald man took the magic stone, counted it casually, and nodded with satisfaction.

    "It's done." He pushed the ring in front of Ethan, "You can identify the owner with a drop of blood. After you identify the owner, only you can use it. Even if you lose it, it will be useless if others pick it up, unless it is cracked with violence, but that thing will explode as soon as it is cracked, and everything inside will be shattered."

    Ethan picked up the ring and stuffed it into his arms.

    "Thanks."

    He turned around and walked out of the shop and walked towards the dormitory area.

    When he returned to the door of the dormitory area, Ethan stopped.

    On the left side of the gate, next to a thick stone pillar, there is a skeleton.

    It was sitting at the base of the stone pillar, its two leg bones stretched out on the ground, its spine bent into a comfortable arc, its head hanging slightly, as if it was taking a nap.

    "Well, the spirit bone guards can also be lazy, right? That's strange."

    Hearing the footsteps, the skeleton raised its head and the soul fire jumped twice.

    "Rebirth?" The spirit bone guard said lazily, "Why are you wandering around?"

    Ethan took out a magic stone from his arms and said, "Master Guard, I want to ask you something."

    The skeleton's soul fire jumped.

    "Hey, you know the rules." It took the magic stone and stuffed it into its robe, "Ask."

    Ethan took out the storage ring he just bought from his arms and handed it over.

    "Is there a problem with this?"

    The spirit bone guard took the ring and looked at it over and over again. It raised its other bone hand, pointed its fingertips on the surface of the ring, and a faint green light lit up at its fingertips.

    After about three breaths, it took back its hand and threw the ring back to Ethan.

    "No problem." It leaned back against the stone pillar, its tone still in that lazy tone, "The structure of this storage magic weapon is very simple, there is no complicated work. It will recognize its owner when it sheds blood, and only you can use it after recognizing its owner. What tricks do you want to do? You can't do it."
title_en: Chapter 18 Lord Guard, I want to ask you something
